title: JSON and Data Boundaries
summary: Distinguish JSON text from JavaScript values, parse incoming text, and check the broad shape of parsed data.

sketchBlocks.title: JSON.parse turns JSON text into values your code can use
sketchBlocks.bodyMarkdown:
**JSON** is a text format for representing data.

```js
const rawProfile = '{"name":"Maya","score":18}';
const profile = JSON.parse(rawProfile);

console.log(profile.name);
```

Line by line:

1. `rawProfile` is one JavaScript string containing JSON text.
2. `JSON.parse(rawProfile)` creates a JavaScript object.
3. `profile.name` works because the parsed value is now an object.
4. The Console shows `Maya`.

Parsing is a **boundary step**: data crosses from an external text representation into JavaScript values.
